entities.summary: Leo Alexander was an American psychiatrist, neurologist, educator, and author, of Austrian-Jewish origin. He was a key medical advisor during the Nuremberg trials. Alexander wrote part of the Nuremberg Code, which provides legal and ethical principles for human experimentation.
